# Advanced GitHub Changelog Generator Configuration

This example demonstrates the comprehensive configuration options available for `github-changelog-generator`.

## Configuration File

The `.github_changelog_generator` file contains all available configuration options with explanations.

## Configuration Options Explained

### Repository Information

```ini
user=github-changelog-generator
project=github-changelog-generator
```

Specifies the GitHub repository owner and name. These are required for the tool to fetch issues and PRs.

### Version Range

```ini
since-tag=1.0.0
due-tag=2.0.0
```

Generate changelog only for commits between these tags. Useful for creating partial changelogs.

### Output Configuration

```ini
output=CHANGELOG.md
base=HISTORY.md
header=# Changelog
```

- `output`: Name of the generated changelog file
- `base`: Optional base file to append changes to
- `header`: Custom header text for the changelog

### Unreleased Changes

```ini
unreleased=true
unreleased-label=**Unreleased**
unreleased-only=false
```

- `unreleased`: Include unreleased changes (commits since last tag)
- `unreleased-label`: Label for the unreleased section
- `unreleased-only`: Generate only unreleased changes

### Date Format

```ini
date-format=%Y-%m-%d
```

Customize how dates appear in the changelog. Uses strftime format:
- `%Y-%m-%d`: 2024-01-15
- `%B %d, %Y`: January 15, 2024
- `%d/%m/%Y`: 15/01/2024

### Label Categories

Labels help organize issues and PRs into semantic categories:

```ini
enhancement-labels=enhancement,feature,Feature,Enhancement
bug-labels=bug,Bug,fix,bugfix,hotfix
breaking-labels=breaking-change,breaking,backwards-incompatible
deprecated-labels=deprecated,deprecation
removed-labels=removed,removal
security-labels=security,Security
```

Issues/PRs with these labels will be grouped under corresponding sections.

### Issue/PR Filtering

```ini
exclude-labels=duplicate,question,invalid,wontfix,no-changelog
```

Issues and PRs with these labels will be excluded from the changelog.

```ini
include-labels=feature,enhancement,bug
```

If specified, only issues/PRs with these labels will be included (commented out by default).

### Breaking Changes

```ini
breaking-prefix=**Breaking Changes:**
breaking-body-only=false
```

Customize how breaking changes are displayed:
- `breaking-prefix`: Prefix for breaking changes section
- `breaking-body-only`: Only show breaking changes from PR/issue bodies

### Section Headers

```ini
bug-prefix=**Fixed bugs:**
enhancement-prefix=**Implemented enhancements:**
issues-prefix=**Closed issues:**
merge-prefix=**Merged pull requests:**
```

Customize the headers for each section in the changelog.

## Usage

### Generate Changelog with This Configuration

```bash
# From the project root
github_changelog_generator --config examples/advanced_config/.github_changelog_generator

# Or from within the advanced_config directory
cd examples/advanced_config
github_changelog_generator
```

### Override Configuration Options

```bash
# Override specific options from command line
github_changelog_generator \
  --config examples/advanced_config/.github_changelog_generator \
  --since-tag v1.5.0 \
  --due-tag v2.0.0
```

### Validate Configuration

```bash
# Check if configuration is valid
github_changelog_generator \
  --config examples/advanced_config/.github_changelog_generator \
  --help
```

## Common Use Cases

### Release Changelog

Generate changelog only for a specific release:

```ini
since-tag=v1.14.0
due-tag=v1.15.0
unreleased=false
```

### Unreleased Changes Only

Show only what's coming in the next release:

```ini
unreleased=true
unreleased-only=true
```

### Filtered by Labels

Include only specific types of changes:

```ini
include-labels=enhancement,feature
exclude-labels=internal,documentation
```

### Custom Sections

Create custom section groupings by defining label categories:

```ini
enhancement-labels=feature,enhancement,improvement
bug-labels=bug,fix,regression
performance-labels=performance,optimization
```

## Sample Output

See `CHANGELOG.md` in this directory for an example of the generated output using this configuration.

## Additional Resources

- [GitHub Changelog Generator Documentation](https://github.com/github-changelog-generator/github-changelog-generator)
- [Configuration Options Reference](https://github.com/github-changelog-generator/github-changelog-generator/wiki/Advanced-change-log-generation-examples)
- [Label Best Practices](https://github.com/github-changelog-generator/github-changelog-generator/wiki/GitHub-labels)

user=github-changelog-generator
project=github-changelog-generator
```

Specifies the GitHub repository owner and name. These are required for the tool to fetch issues and PRs.

### Version Range

```ini
since-tag=1.0.0
due-tag=2.0.0
```

Generate changelog only for commits between these tags. Useful for creating partial changelogs.

### Output Configuration

```ini
output=CHANGELOG.md
base=HISTORY.md
header=# Changelog
```

- `output`: Name of the generated changelog file
- `base`: Optional base file to append changes to
- `header`: Custom header text for the changelog

### Unreleased Changes

```ini
unreleased=true
unreleased-label=**Unreleased**
unreleased-only=false
```

- `unreleased`: Include unreleased changes (commits since last tag)
- `unreleased-label`: Label for the unreleased section
- `unreleased-only`: Generate only unreleased changes

### Date Format

```ini
date-format=%Y-%m-%d
```

Customize how dates appear in the changelog. Uses strftime format:
- `%Y-%m-%d`: 2024-01-15
- `%B %d, %Y`: January 15, 2024
- `%d/%m/%Y`: 15/01/2024

### Label Categories

Labels help organize issues and PRs into semantic categories:

```ini
enhancement-labels=enhancement,feature,Feature,Enhancement
bug-labels=bug,Bug,fix,bugfix,hotfix
breaking-labels=breaking-change,breaking,backwards-incompatible
deprecated-labels=deprecated,deprecation
removed-labels=removed,removal
security-labels=security,Security
```

Issues/PRs with these labels will be grouped under corresponding sections.

### Issue/PR Filtering

```ini
exclude-labels=duplicate,question,invalid,wontfix,no-changelog
```

Issues and PRs with these labels will be excluded from the changelog.

```ini
include-labels=feature,enhancement,bug
```

If specified, only issues/PRs with these labels will be included (commented out by default).

### Breaking Changes

```ini
breaking-prefix=**Breaking Changes:**
breaking-body-only=false
```

Customize how breaking changes are displayed:
- `breaking-prefix`: Prefix for breaking changes section
- `breaking-body-only`: Only show breaking changes from PR/issue bodies

### Section Headers

```ini
bug-prefix=**Fixed bugs:**
enhancement-prefix=**Implemented enhancements:**
issues-prefix=**Closed issues:**
merge-prefix=**Merged pull requests:**
```

Customize the headers for each section in the changelog.
